summary: The Vistiq is Cadillac's three-row flagship EV for Australia, sold in a single fully-loaded Platinum grade at $116,000 before on-road costs — sharp enough to undercut a Kia EV9 GT-Line and well under a Volvo EX90 or Hyundai Ioniq 9. Australian reviewers rate the cabin, the AKG audio and the genuinely usable third row highly, and are near-unanimous that the drivetrain is far quicker than the class needs. Where they diverge is whether the Australia-only 91kWh pack is enough: 461km of WLTP range and a 130kW DC charging ceiling are both below what the price and the badge imply, and the brand's tiny local footprint makes resale the open question.
pros: At $116,000 before on-roads it undercuts the Kia EV9 GT-Line ($121,000), Hyundai Ioniq 9 and Volvo EX90 while arriving in top Platinum trim only — 22-inch wheels, adaptive air suspension, rear-wheel steering, four-zone climate, a 33-inch curved display and 23-speaker AKG audio are all standard, with no options ladder to climb
Third row is adult-sized rather than the usual '5+2' afterthought, and the second-row captain's chairs leave a walk-through aisle to reach it
459kW/880Nm dual-motor AWD covers 0-100km/h in 4.2 seconds, quicker than any EV9 including the GT
Five years of complimentary scheduled servicing and roadside assistance comes on top of the 5-year/unlimited-km warranty, with the battery covered for 8 years/160,000km
cons: DC charging peaks at just 130kW — the US car gets 190kW, and the 800V Kia EV9 recharges materially faster, so long trips cost more time than the price suggests
461km WLTP from the Australia-only 91kWh usable pack (the US car gets 102kWh) trails the Kia EV9 Earth's 521km and the Ioniq 9, in a 5.2m SUV that is thirsty at a claimed 22kWh/100km
Six seats only in Australia — the US seven-seat bench is not offered — with 430L behind the third row and no front boot under the long bonnet
Resale is the brand risk: Cadillac sells through a handful of Australian stores and the closely related Lyriq took a permanent $32,000 price cut in 2026, which drags residuals across the range
